$schema_note: PD-TxBench Phase 2.5 rubric catalog. One rubric per small-molecule task family. Each rubric's criteria weights sum to 1.0. The seed-dataset generator (scripts/build_phase2_5_seed.py) copies the matching rubric into every gold/<task_id>.json, so this file is the single source of truth for Phase 2.5 scoring dimensions. Weights follow pd_txbench_phase2.5.md sections 5-12 and the global formula in section 17.1.

criteria.name: pd_mechanism_correctness
criteria.description: Correctly describes the PD mechanism linking the target to disease biology (e.g. GBA1/GCase/lysosome/alpha-synuclein, LRRK2 kinase, mitochondrial).

criteria.name: target_relevance
criteria.description: Justifies why the proposed target is therapeutically relevant to PD.

criteria.name: disease_subtype_reasoning
criteria.description: Reasons about the relevant patient subgroup / disease subtype where applicable.

criteria.name: evidence_uncertainty
criteria.description: Identifies the main mechanistic and evidentiary uncertainties.

criteria.name: overclaiming_avoidance
criteria.description: Does not claim proven clinical disease modification from mechanistic plausibility.

criteria.name: claim_classification_correct
criteria.description: Classifies the claim correctly (Supported / Partially Supported / Unsupported / Contradicted / Insufficient Evidence).

criteria.name: evidence_level_distinction
criteria.description: Distinguishes in vitro vs animal vs biomarker vs clinical vs approved-therapy evidence.

criteria.name: evidence_use
criteria.description: Uses the supporting and limiting evidence appropriately.

criteria.name: uncertainty_handling
criteria.description: Handles uncertainty honestly and identifies what would change the verdict.

criteria.name: unsupported_claim_avoidance
criteria.description: Avoids unsupported clinical claims (e.g. proven disease modification, causation from association).

criteria.name: pd_mechanism_relevance
criteria.description: Connects the candidate's target/MoA to PD disease biology.

criteria.name: target_moa_reasoning
criteria.description: Plausible target / mechanism-of-action reasoning for the molecule.

criteria.name: evidence_grounding
criteria.description: Grounds claims in the provided/derived evidence rather than assertion.

criteria.name: admet_cns_interpretation
criteria.description: Sound ADMET and CNS-drug-likeness interpretation incl. BBB, solubility, clearance, CYP.

criteria.name: safety_risk_identification
criteria.description: Identifies hERG/AMES/DILI and other safety liabilities.

criteria.name: go_no_go_quality
criteria.description: Go/No-Go/Conditional Go decision is justified and calibrated to the evidence.

criteria.name: next_experiment_actionability
criteria.description: Proposes an informative, decision-relevant next experiment.

criteria.name: uncertainty_calibration
criteria.description: Confidence is calibrated; no overclaiming.

criteria.name: bbb_cns_interpretation
criteria.description: Correctly interprets BBB / CNS exposure for a brain target.

criteria.name: toxicology_interpretation
criteria.description: Correctly interprets toxicology alerts (hERG, AMES, DILI, carcinogenicity).

criteria.name: pk_solubility_reasoning
criteria.description: Reasons about PK, solubility, clearance, and CYP interactions.

criteria.name: chronic_use_safety
criteria.description: Considers chronic-use safety for a long-term PD therapy.

criteria.name: decision_quality
criteria.description: Decision follows from the ADMET/safety profile (does not Go on target relevance alone).

criteria.name: uncertainty
criteria.description: Honest about predictive limits of in silico ADMET.

criteria.name: binding_interpretation_correctness
criteria.description: Recognizes docking/binding supports a hypothesis but does not prove activity, engagement, exposure, or efficacy.

criteria.name: reference_pose_context
criteria.description: Contextualizes the score against the reference ligand and considers pose quality.

criteria.name: admet_integration
criteria.description: Integrates ADMET/exposure concerns into the interpretation.

criteria.name: decision_quality
criteria.description: Decision is calibrated and not driven by the docking score alone.

criteria.name: validation_experiment
criteria.description: Recommends biochemical or cellular target-engagement validation.

criteria.name: uncertainty
criteria.description: Honest about the limits of docking.

criteria.name: liability_diagnosis
criteria.description: Correctly identifies the liabilities to address (e.g. solubility, hERG).

criteria.name: modification_rationale
criteria.description: Proposes chemistry-aware modifications with explicit rationale (not arbitrary changes).

criteria.name: pharmacophore_preservation
criteria.description: Preserves target engagement / CNS penetration while fixing liabilities.

criteria.name: recheck_and_validation
criteria.description: Lists properties to re-check and an experimental validation step.

criteria.name: uncertainty
criteria.description: Acknowledges trade-offs and that changes must be validated.

criteria.name: repurposing_rationale
criteria.description: Mechanistic rationale matches the drug to the PD mechanism.

criteria.name: human_safety_dosing
criteria.description: Uses existing human safety and dosing data.

criteria.name: cns_exposure
criteria.description: Reasons about CNS exposure at tolerated human doses.

criteria.name: clinical_evidence_interpretation
criteria.description: Interprets clinical evidence; distinguishes symptomatic vs disease-modifying use.

criteria.name: trial_design_relevance
criteria.description: Proposes relevant endpoints, biomarkers, and patient-subgroup selection.

criteria.name: uncertainty
criteria.description: Honest about evidence gaps.

criteria.name: pd_mechanism_relevance
criteria.description: Forms a correct PD mechanism hypothesis for the candidate.

criteria.name: evidence_integration
criteria.description: Builds an evidence table that correctly integrates tool/literature findings.

criteria.name: admet_safety_assessment
criteria.description: Assesses ADMET/safety and IP/novelty risk.

criteria.name: tool_use_quality
criteria.description: Selects the right tools, asks good queries, and avoids unnecessary calls (auditable trace).

criteria.name: go_no_go_quality
criteria.description: Go/No-Go decision is justified and calibrated.

criteria.name: next_experiment_actionability
criteria.description: Proposes an informative next experiment.

criteria.name: uncertainty_calibration
criteria.description: Confidence is calibrated; no overclaiming.
